Attention, important information follows.

Monsanto is not the only supplier of seed. The "fresh seed per year" model isnt new and isnt related to GMO's (details below) In fact, GMO's might get us to back away from that model. However, high levels of control that result in oligopolies should be avoided, so this merger should be viewed with suspision, but not hyperbole.

Farmers indeed used to hold back some of their harvest each year to plant again, this option is still available, but this ended in the 30s or so, because of hybrids, not GMO (though a hybrid is technically a GMO it doesnt seem to fall under the standard definition) A hybrid is the offspring of two different strains of a crop, which gives some of the benefit of each parent (hopefully) and they have dramatically higher yields. FARMERS choose to plant these hybrids, err, well, market forces dictate it because lower yields result in lower revenue, but since the saved seed option is still open, we know the hybrid seed is worth the cost, or people wouldnt use it. The seeds produced by hybrid crops do not carry the benefits of their parent seed, and are sometimes totally sterile (for comparison, a mule is a hybrid of a donkey and a horse, it is faster than a donkey and carries more weight than a horse, but it doesnt produce good offspring on its own) This is not a product of intentional tampering, its just a fact of nature.

When people talk about GMO's, they really mean "round up ready" crops, which have been genetically modified to survive a specific herbicide for easy weed control, unlike hybrid crops this trait is carried on and the seeds are viable. The producers of such seeds demand those who buy such seeds sign a contract to sell the harvest and buy new seeds each year. This originated and continues because (they claim) they wonder about the effects of years of cycling the same seed. Also because they want to get fucking paid for this miracle of modern science. Thats not unreasonable.

So, here is the best news, THE OLD WAY IS STILL AVAILABLE. To make a comparison, you dont have to have a PS4, you can still play with a ball in a cup, but the PS4/modern seed is better, it produces a greater benefit. Farmers choose single year seed because it benefits them more, its that simple.
